feederCalibrationPanel.heading: Feeder
feederCalibrationPanel.speedTooltip: How fast the feeder wheel turns (120 = slowest, 490 = fastest). Lower is gentler on cards; higher feeds faster but can double-feed.
feederCalibrationPanel.pulseDurationDescription: How long the wheel spins in one nudge. Use Continuous to run it non-stop.
feederCalibrationPanel.pauseDurationDescription: Rest time between nudges. Longer pauses reduce double-feeds.
feederCalibrationPanel.settleDurationDescription: Extra time to keep feeding once the first card sensor sees the card, so it travels all the way into the mechanism before the motor stops.

irSensorPanel.label: Card sensors
irSensorPanel.tooltip: Infrared sensors that spot a card at each sorting arm's feed path
irSensorPanel.monitorTooltip: Keep checking the sensors and update these badges as cards move
irSensorPanel.readTooltip: Take a single reading right now
irSensorPanel.detectedTooltip: A card is at sorting arm {{module}}'s sensor right now
irSensorPanel.notDetectedTooltip: No card at sorting arm {{module}}'s sensor
irSensorPanel.hopperTooltip: Whether the hopper's sensor sees cards waiting to be fed

moduleCalibrationGrid.sliderTooltip: Arm position (120–490). Move the arm with the buttons above, then press a Set button to remember that position.

scanRegionCalibrationPanel.instructions: Drag each corner onto a corner of a card sitting at the camera (sorting arm 1), or drag inside the shape to move all four. The photo is straightened to the shape you set.
scanRegionCalibrationPanel.savedNoCorners: Scan area not set yet — showing the old rectangle. Drag a corner to start.
scanRegionCalibrationPanel.settleDelayHint: How long to wait after the sensor sees a card before the photo is taken. Raise this if captures show the card still sliding.
